## Shared image-memory batch: actual startup blocker, no closure

[Run40989310808](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40989310808) at `35b266c88fc243ca672cebad1dd31d34eebb423c` successfully compiles and links the repaired test fixture, then **fails before UIApplication activation: zero XML, zero executed native/GC/allocation/leak methods**. Gradle exits1/1361.63s; all890 exact Git library inputs match before/after and owned app cleanup succeeds.

The strict test-only Kotlin/Native mode (`runtimeAssertionsMode=panic`, `checkStateAtExternalCalls=true`) aborts at `ObjCInterop.mm:278`, “Unable to add protocol to Objective-C class”, in `CreateKotlinObjCClass`/Compose's eager accessibility initializer. The exact class/protocol/root cause is not established. This is not a demonstrated default-production crash. The prepared Instruments session **never starts** (`commands=[]`, `exports=[]`, `profile_passed=false`); console exit0 and absence of an owned crash report are not native success/crash-absence evidence.

[Independent review and public-source analysis](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/16c9a53026cb087f359a45bcfbbe4d56c1473243/docs/development/evidence/image-memory-batch-important-20261030/native-ci002) retain the failure. Nine accepted unchanged UIImage methods are reused, not rerun. Original native GC/failure/profile/diagnostic criteria remain; #140 and #141 stay open. No unchanged strict rerun, silently disabled assertions, package/release/Pages publication or release/security-gate clearance.
